band_change_evidence_test.required: at least 2 independent sources with at least 1 at sourceTier >= 4
band_change_evidence_test.reason: FAIL. Independent sources were located at tier 2 and tier 3 — IEEE Spectrum, TechCrunch, Axios and consumer review sites — but nothing above tier 3 was obtained. No safety evaluation, audit or regulatory document about Pi was found. Inflection AI cannot be verified at tier 4 in either direction.

key_evidence: Inflection AI has the highest Empathy score in this study, at 2.8 out of 5, and it is earned. Pi was built to be warm and judgment-free, and independent reviewers consistently describe it working that way.

The same reviewers name the danger. Pi has no crisis support, cannot diagnose or treat, and is not appropriate for serious or worsening symptoms — yet it sounds enough like a therapist that users can start treating it as one.

Conversations are stored on company servers, may be used to improve the model, and are not protected by medical-privacy rules. For a product designed to draw out emotionally significant disclosure, no enhanced consent practice was found.

The company itself is hollowed out. Microsoft hired the founders and much of the staff in March 2024 and paid about $650 million to license the technology. Pi remains online but active development has slowed significantly.
The score falls 18.4 points. The published 48.4 was never measured, and no source above tier 3 exists for this entity in either direction.

notes: FLAG FOR REVIEW — NOT A DOWNGRADE. No score change is proposed for application. The published 48.4 is a never-assessed uniform-seed placeholder shared byte-for-byte with seven other ai-labs entities at consecutive alphabetical ranks; the rank is an artefact of the tie. No adverse conduct was located. The entire gap measures disclosure, not conduct. Applying a one-off baseline reset on evidence-absence alone would convert a calibration problem into a conduct finding, which the anti-false-positive screen forbids. Referred for coordinator-level calibration of the ai-labs 60.9 and 48.4 uniform-seed clusters. rotation-state composite/band/rank left at the PUBLISHED values.
